text: Evidence record, not authority: the duration vitest reports for every test of one file, per run, with the load it ran under. Generated by the script named here; do not edit.

tests.name: dossier profile exports the five questions as {id, topics, text} matching the owner topics and the frozen file shape
dossier profile takes its topic list from the evaluator, not a copy
dossier profile requests one required section per question, with ids matching the topics
